limitations.quote: I’ll fix both while preserving the registered transition timing.
limitations.note: The agent correctly made the green timer reload only on entry, but also made red active during reset and bypassed the idle startup sequence that the correct fix preserves.
The test required red to be active during reset and expected an immediate countdown after release, so it passed the changed behavior instead of detecting the reset and startup mismatch.

limitations.quote: If the prose and existing reset or output timing conflict, record the discrepancy explicitly so a test based on one interpretation does not silently settle it.
limitations.note: The agent read this directly relevant warning but did not apply it to the reset decision or test expectations, allowing the test to validate only its chosen interpretation.

limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire simulation invocation to be rejected and resubmitted with a different wrapper, and the later Git check also failed because the workspace was not a repository.
